content.short: SpotSpreads is an AI-powered market making protocol on Mantle providing intelligent, adaptive liquidity provision and optimal spread management.
content.description: SpotSpreads is an AI-driven market making protocol that uses machine learning algorithms to continuously optimize bid-ask spreads and liquidity placement on Mantle DEXes based on real-time volatility, volume, and inventory risk signals. This adaptive approach enables more efficient liquidity provision than static AMM models and aims to bring institutional market making efficiency to decentralized exchanges. SpotSpreads represents a new class of AI-native DeFi infrastructure built for the Mantle ecosystem.
